messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: high 5xx rate for service inference-gateway-eu2 (route /v1/generate). P95 error rate 6.2% (threshold 3%). PD: INC-2026-834.
ben: acked — I'm the current oncall, jumping in.
alice: pulling metrics, looks like spike started ~10:11 UTC right after canary deploy `canary-2026-03-17-10` rolled to 20%. CPU fine, but backend pool eu2-inference shows many 502s.
carla: any recent infra changes beside the canary? autoscaler config?
dave: logs show upstreams returning 502 with "kvcache timeout" and a few 504s from kv-proxy. sample from logs:```[10:12:04] inference-gateway: request_id=abc123 upstream_error=502 kv_timeout=1500ms route=/v1/generate user_id=...```
alice: dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/slo/inference/eu2 — errorBudgetBurn: 4.1%/hr. Customer impact: increased retries and elevated latency for smaller payloads.
ben: quick mitigation plan: 1) divert traffic off canary -> rollback canary 2) scale eu2-inference pool 3) warm kv-proxy or switch to secondary cache region fallback. I'll start 1 & 2.
carla: pinging infra to confirm spare capacity in eu2.
dave: running probe against worker:```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://eu2.prod.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'``` got: "HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway" and upstream id: eu2-kv-01.
ben: executing rollback: `kubectl -n prod-eu2 rollout undo deployment/inference-canary --to-revision=42` (starting now).
alice: scaling: `kubectl -n prod-eu2 scale deployment inference-worker --replicas=16` — issuing.
pagerduty: Note: escalation policy notified: infra, eng-runtime, eng-oncall. Pager acknowledged by ben at 10:14:05 UTC.
carla: infra confirmed spare GPU nodes available, prepping to attach. ETA ~5m.
dave: adding temporary route fallback: set route weight inference-eu2:primary=0.7 fallback=0.3 via routing-service. command: `redwood route update --service inference-gateway --region eu2 --weights primary=70,fallback=30`
alice: after rollback + scale, I see 5xx rate drop to 2.8% at 10:17 UTC. p95 latency trending down.
ben: leaving a quick checklist for next oncall: cause appears to be kv-proxy timeouts triggered by canary change; mitigations: rollback, scale, warm cache, consider kvcache connection limits.
carla: can we capture heap/conn metrics for kv-proxy and open a follow-up ticket for root cause?
ben: creating follow-up GH issue: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/issues/5921 — linking logs and timeline.
dave: snapshotting request traces and adding a few suspicious trace IDs to the issue.
erin: taking over for next shift in 15m, will continue watch. please add me to PD incident and leave any remaining tasks.
ben: handing off — ben -> erin. current state: degraded -> recovering, rollback applied, worker pool scaled, error rate down but still above baseline. watch for recurrence for next 30m.
erin: acked and on it. I'll keep PD updated and coordinate with infra if it spikes again. :thumbsup:
